reviews.title: Latest update awful
reviews.text: The latest update has changed calculations and the tides for the west coast of Florida are totally incorrect.  My daughter has an older version (2.43) on her phone and it is still correct.  Need to find a new tide app now since I can’t roll back

reviews.title: Sucks on Apple Watch
reviews.text: The new Apple Watch app of this application makes it impossible to see the high and low tide at a glance …. The older version was really obvious and you easily see low and high tide arrows - now it’s a confusing dot in a circle and bears no resemblance to the phone app or the old watch app - should revert back to the old watch display format

reviews.title: Undo the Apple Watch update.
reviews.text: I use this app for work and the old display was perfect. Now it’s too cluttered and harder to get the info I need quickly. I’m not happy about it at all.

reviews.title: Why did you change the UI on the Apple Watch?
reviews.text:
I loved this app and looked at it every single day but now the tide readings on my watch are MUCH harder to read. Give us the simple view as an option - bring it back please

I  am downloading other tides apps today

reviews.title: Advertisements
reviews.text: Ants have started appearing at the bottom of my screen. It looks like for ladies underwear or something slightly obscene. I’d like to know how to get rid of them.

reviews.title: Watch Update is Terrible
reviews.text:
Edit: Thank you for reaching out. The issue is the icon on the watchface, not the chart. 

The watch home screen graphic makes no sense. I used to easily be able to check the tide at a glance. Now I don’t know what it means and it’s hard to see without reading glasses. Used to not need to put them on.

reviews.title: Screen view
reviews.text: The at time of tide seems to hug one side or the other on the screen, pretty irritating!

reviews.title: Why ?
reviews.text: Ok a few things since I use this app allllll the time. The calendar has mistakes with you showing no tide information on thanksgiving and Christmas … but your daily chart shows it…. The visuals are more compressed and it doesn’t look as good… the calendar date blocks are a little small and you can barely discern the full moon in it.  Visually speaking I don’t think it looks better or more readable at all. New updates need some fixies guys

reviews.title: Most recent update sucks
reviews.text: They just updated the watch app, and it really sucks.  The tide app on my watch used to be my favorite complication.  I could tell at a glance what the tide was doing.  There was an arrow indicating a lot of really useful information at a glance.  After the update it really doesn’t work at all.  The complication will tell me one thing, but the phone app another (I think the phone is right), and it’s presented in a format that’s hard to interpret.  When I open the complication, again the watch app and the phone app don’t agree.  I use the tide app multiple times a day, and I’ll probably need to delete this one now and find one that works.  I wish they would go back to the old one which worked great.
